body:
REVIEW DISPOSITION: ACCEPT the profile-outcome correction, with four binding refinements.

1. NotAttempted must not have an optional receipt. Every requested profile receives exactly one outcome and every outcome carries a disposition receipt binding the reason, causal prerequisite(s), policy/profile version, and execution identity. Otherwise the honest non-execution path is the least auditable one.

2. Produced preview bytes are necessary but not sufficient for Satisfied. The certification receipt must bind the exact profile schema/version, browser_preview role/path/media type/checksum, every required local asset role/checksum, verifier identity/version, and the enumerated court outcomes. A produced but invalid preview is lawful as Produced plus Failed(profile); it must not be coerced to either missing bytes or conformance.

3. Profile implication is typed. If network-independent is defined as a stronger profile over the same preview, Satisfied(network-independent) implies Satisfied(local-open) for the same role identities and receipt lineage. Failed or NotAttempted local-open makes the stronger profile Failed/NotAttempted, never independently Satisfied. Network-independent remains an optional design profile, not owner-derived law.

4. Failures are closed typed codes with evidence references, not raw exception/log text. This preserves deterministic decoding and avoids turning a report failure into an unbounded disclosure channel.

Mutation-capable courts: flip local-open to Satisfied with no produced preview; mutate a required asset after certification while leaving preview.html unchanged; set network-independent Satisfied while local-open is Failed; remove the NotAttempted disposition receipt; and keep preview Produced while a local-open court fails. The first four must refuse; the last must preserve the bytes and record Failed(profile).

This is exactly the A5 distinction: report production and profile certification are separate outcomes. With these refinements, ACCEPT. No repository implementation or dependency authority is implied.
